executionVersusCommand.meaning: This route reads automation execution records, not /command-history, live automation SSE events, or a vehicle-command acknowledgement stream. Row status is the execution outcome; actions_succeeded/actions_total are recorded action counts, not proof of downstream vehicle effect. Business partial differs from partial source availability. FSM transitions are time-window associations, not causal proof that the execution caused each transition.
executionVersusCommand.actions: New automation and Manage rules navigate only. Filter/page changes alter URL/read scope; opening detail supplies a history record ID. No run/test/undo/retry-command mutation is called by these five feature files.

vehicleAndHeaderRange.meaning: The actual /automations/history route is fleet/workflow scoped: the /automations prefix intentionally disables the header vehicle picker. The page does not consume a selected vehicle and sends no vehicle filter; rule filtering is not vehicle filtering. No vehicle-filter capability is invented. The header and mobile drawer provide the one shared range control; no duplicate page picker exists. Header ownership ignores the page persistKey and inherits workspace defaults/preferences.
vehicleAndHeaderRange.bounds: startInstant -> since and endInstantExclusive -> until; RFC3339 inclusive lower/exclusive upper. Custom/calendar timezone and rolling 24h/live semantics remain in useRangeState. Calendar interpretation defaults to browser timezone; DateTime in=user can use a different saved timezone_user. That mismatch is disclosed below, not silently corrected.

sourceContracts.hookVerification: Four relevant route shapes match source registration; no actual requests. limit/offset/status/since/until use exact backend names; the rule ID chooses the per-rule route, not an unsupported global automation_id query. All three read hooks forward signal; detail enables only for non-null ID. History key contains every page/rule/status/bound input.

paginationAndDenominators.meaning: Server page size is 25; offset=(page-1)*25. Page count uses envelope total, not loaded rows. SQL count/list/summary/trend use the same HistoryFilter and both bounds; only row fetch applies limit/offset. Stable row ordering is triggered_at DESC,id DESC. Rule/status/range changes reset pagination; high URL pages are clamped after data resolves. Success-rate denominator excludes running/skipped/cancelled/test/undo; summary count differs intentionally from list total. Average-duration population differs from completed-count population (AHQA-03).
paginationAndDenominators.loadedVersusFull: DataTable receives only current server rows and has its own explicitly labeled Search loaded rows/default loaded-row exports. Separate page Pagination controls full server paging. No full-range export/search or chart CSV/fullscreen capability is claimed. Trend preserves totals when folding UTC daily rows into period prefixes; resolution thresholds use trend row count, not elapsed days.

trust.meaning: With retained data, refresh failure/paused status does not replace rows, summary, chart or detail with a fatal error. Shared warnings provide nonblocking retry; independent rule-list failure does not erase history. Initial genuine error uses QueryError. Successful validated empty history has an explanatory state and Manage rules link. Missing duration is a dash; zero duration remains zero; zero completed runs makes rate/average undefined. Cold paused/no-data behavior is not authoritative emptiness (AHQA-01).
trust.coupling: Rows/count/summary/trend are one backend envelope; aggregate failure fails that source rather than retaining a separately fresh subsource. Rule options and execution detail are separate queries.
trust.freshnessLimit: DataState computes last-success time but page summary freshness text is static and warning does not show an actual age. No fresh/live correctness claim. No polling/recovery behavior was exercised.

rawSiSignDisplayLocalePreferences.meaning: Hooks preserve raw payloads. Existing execution timing wire fields duration_ms/avg_duration_ms are milliseconds, not canonical SI seconds; this historical instrumentation contract is disclosed, not remigrated in QA. The brief adapts avg milliseconds to raw metric seconds (/1000) and formats at display (x1000); row/detail use the millisecond formatter. Primary content has no distance/speed/temperature/pressure/energy values requiring automotive unit conversion. Opaque action JSON is raw diagnostic content, not validated physical display. No legacy converter call was found.
rawSiSignDisplayLocalePreferences.preferences: Brief/number adapters and DateTime subscribe to existing settings; durations/rate use locale/precision-aware numeric formatting. Row/detail action-count ratios bypass that path (AHQA-07). DateTime in=user uses saved user timezone/locale, while range defaults to browser timezone and trend buckets are UTC (AHQA-04). Existing date FormatOptions do not carry an explicit 12/24h preference; that preference mapping is not claimed verified.
rawSiSignDisplayLocalePreferences.signs: No abs/clamp rewrites of measured source values in these five files. Negative elapsed durations are invalid, not a valid signed physical quantity; the shared row/detail formatter currently displays them (AHQA-08). Null versus zero brief behavior is explicit. Invalid/huge/signed automotive measurements inside opaque JSON remain unverified.
rawSiSignDisplayLocalePreferences.observability: No page-local RUM bootstrap or direct EventSource/fetch appears. List history handlers create spans and traced errors; detail handler lacks the same required instrumentation (AHQA-09).

findings.mechanism: No-data paused query can be pending but not isLoading. Page loading gate tests isLoading only; fatalError is null for paused initial state and rows default to []. It therefore selects the authoritative 'No executions match' branch without a successful response. Summary marks unavailable, chart renders nonloading empty points without empty=true, and detail selects unavailable on the equivalent source state.
findings.need: Handle initial/paused without retained data distinctly from successful empty; preserve retained source branches and individual recovery.
findings.evidenceClass: Source branch mechanism; offline reproduction NOTRUN

findings.rule: MDC-026; section identity and partial/unknown source completeness
findings.mechanism: Action-results and FSM-transition sections disappear when arrays are empty/null. The backend additionally maps no vehicle, successful empty and FSM lookup error to the same [] and discards the returned count from a 100-row query. A successful outer record does not prove complete transitions or successful transition retrieval.
findings.owner: Parent-assigned automation-history feature owner plus execution-detail API/type integration owner
findings.need: Keep neutral subsection shells; expose availability/failure/truncation metadata at the integration owner before asserting no transitions or complete history. Preserve the existing record payload.
findings.evidenceClass: Source-proven conditional suppression and information loss; backend execution NOTRUN

findings.mechanism: Completed count excludes running/skipped/cancelled/test/undo; AVG(duration_ms) excludes only test/undo and missing durations. Thus skipped/cancelled/running rows with recorded duration can contribute to the average accompanying Completed runs. Brief hides the average entirely when completed count is zero, regardless of the average's distinct population.
findings.owner: Automation-history aggregate integration owner; feature owner for accurate population description
findings.need: Agree and disclose the duration population, or align SQL with the intended completed-run population. Do not silently recalculate from page rows.
findings.evidenceClass: Source-defined population mismatch; existence/frequency of affected records NOTRUN

findings.rule: MDC-044; timezone and localized period interpretation
findings.mechanism: Trend day strings originate from UTC SQL buckets, are sliced into raw ISO periods and shown on XAxis/fallback Period without UTC/resolution disclosure. User-context record timestamps can be rendered in a saved timezone different from the browser-calendar range and from UTC buckets. This is not evidence of incorrectly filtered SQL, but the visible period interpretation is ambiguous.
findings.owner: Automation-history chart feature owner; existing workspace date/format owner for any shared timezone-policy change
findings.need: Disclose actual UTC bucket timezone/resolution and format display labels with existing locale tools without re-bucketing aggregates blindly.
findings.evidenceClass: Source-defined timezone mismatch/disclosure gap; DST/locale interaction NOTRUN

findings.mechanism: All three Bar fills are feature-local fixed hex values rather than deriving from the existing chart/semantic preference owners. Shared frame styling does not transform these explicit incoming series fills.
findings.need: Use existing restrained chart/semantic roles while preserving success/failed/other identities, counts, hidden-series state and saved preferences.
findings.evidenceClass: Three actual fixed-fill source matches; rendered saturation/contrast NOTRUN

findings.mechanism: Detail buttons use only the rule name (or Rule #id), !h-auto and !p-0. Repeated executions of a rule have identical accessible action names. Below md, the supplied rule/status allow-list hides Triggered time; no mobilePresentation is supplied, so visible rows can be indistinguishable until individually opened. The detail does preserve hidden metadata, so this is not total field loss. Source overrides remove the shared button's default height/padding; an actual WCAG spacing/size exception has not been demonstrated.
findings.need: Preserve an execution-specific mobile identity/accessibility name and an adequate existing shared target; retain every hidden field/detail action.
findings.evidenceClass: Source identity/target override mechanism; measured pixel targets and native/keyboard behavior NOTRUN

findings.mechanism: Succeeded/total action counts are interpolated directly into a string rather than using the subscribed locale-aware integer formatter. Detail renders the same numbers directly. Locale/number-system settings therefore do not govern these counts, unlike rate and duration formatting.
findings.need: Format each known action count through existing locale-aware count formatting, retaining exact ratio meaning and unknown/invalid distinctions.
findings.evidenceClass: Source formatter bypass; locale runtime NOTRUN

findings.mechanism: formatDurationMs rejects non-finite/null input but not negative elapsed durations; any negative finite value enters the '<1000' branch and is displayed as negative milliseconds. Row/detail pass every non-null duration_ms directly. assertHistoryPage validates row identity/status but not duration, so source validation does not close this path. The brief's duration metric adapter and row/detail display can consequently disagree on invalid duration handling.
findings.owner: Existing date/number-format owner, with bounded automation-history caller regression responsibility
findings.need: Treat negative elapsed duration as invalid, without erasing legitimate zero or signs on unrelated physical/net metrics.
findings.evidenceClass: Source predicate/call-path evidence; no malformed payload supplied and no tests executed

findings.mechanism: GetHistoryDetail does not create the required handler-local span, unlike both history-list handlers. Its record-read Error log has no trace_id; its optional FSM warning also lacks trace context. This is a direct read-endpoint observability gap, not a claim that global HTTP tracing is absent.
findings.need: Apply existing handler span/error trace propagation at that integration owner; no backend changes in this QA item.
findings.evidenceClass: Source instrumentation absence; trace collector/runtime NOTRUN
